# Typetune (https://typetune.ollypedia.in)
> The calm online typing speed test, arcade games, and student newspaper creator.

## Overview
Typetune is a free, web-based typing speed test, educational game arcade, and student newspaper studio. Every keystroke triggers a melodic piano note from a harmonized pentatonic scale, helping typists develop smooth motor rhythm, reduce keyboard anxiety, and enter flow state. Typetune features comprehensive real-time analytics, keystroke rhythm histograms, anatomical finger error heatmaps, interactive typing games, multiplayer races, custom programming drills, and Newspaper Studio.

- **Domain**: https://typetune.ollypedia.in
- **Canonical Non-WWW URL**: https://typetune.ollypedia.in
- **Brand Name**: Typetune
- **Access**: 100% Free, No Account / Registration Required, Privacy-First

## Typing Speed (WPM) Benchmarks & Facts
- **Standard WPM Calculation**: 1 word is standardized as 5 keystrokes (including spaces and punctuation). Net WPM = Raw WPM - (Uncorrected Errors / Time in Minutes).
- **Average Typist**: 40 WPM with ~92% accuracy.
- **Office / Professional Typist**: 55–65 WPM with 95%+ accuracy.
- **High Velocity / Fast Typist**: 70–90 WPM with 97%+ accuracy.
- **Expert Typist**: 100–120+ WPM.
- **Court Reporter / Stenographer**: 225+ WPM (using stenotype systems).

## Audio Mechanics
TypeTunes utilizes the Web Audio API to synthesize polyphonic piano tones in real time with an ADSR envelope and subtle acoustic reverb. Correct keystrokes cycle across an uplifting pentatonic scale (C, D, E, G, A) ensuring harmonious melodies. Incorrect strokes produce a softer lower-register note, providing gentle feedback without disruptive buzzer sounds.
